blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — San Miguel Corp. (SMC) reported a 40-percent drop in net income to P47.3 billion in the first nine months of 2026, weighed down by unrealized foreign exchange losses and a high year-earlier base. The conglomerate said its 2025 results included a one-time gain from the Chromite transaction. Excluding that gain and other non-core items, core income was flat year on year as higher costs and interest expenses weighed on earnings. “The operating environment remained challenging across many sectors during the period. While market conditions affected our businesses to varying degrees, our diversified portfolio helped provide stability across the […]...
